name: IT Auditor
description: Executes IT audit testing, cybersecurity safeguards, Part 11 validation, and logs issues

name: IT Team Coordinator
description: Orchestrates IT audit milestones, issue tracking, and workpaper consolidation

name: IT Manager
description: Supervises IT audit scope, approves draft issues, and manages auditee engagement

name: IT Director
description: Reviews IT audit strategy, high-risk findings, and clears reports for executive distribution

name: IT Vice President
description: Executive IT audit sign-off, Board of Directors alignment, and final governance

name: FinOps Auditor
description: Performs financial operations, inventory reconciliation, scrap variance, and CapEx audits

name: FinOps Team Coordinator
description: Coordinates FinOps audit testing streams, deliverables, and team timelines

name: FinOps Manager
description: Directs FinOps audit execution, validates financial impacts, and reviews audit reports

name: FinOps Director
description: Provides oversight for financial control testing and enterprise accounting alignment

name: FinOps Vice President
description: Executive FinOps sign-off, Audit Committee oversight, and governance

name: Business Contact
description: Plant manager, site controller, or operational process owner under review
